== Biography ==
William Glasgow was born 26 Dec 1680 at Glencorse, Scotland. He was the son of [[Glasgow-3012|John Glasgow]] and [[Currie-4998|Margaret Currie]].<ref>Scotland, Old Parish Registers, Glencorse Parish, 26 Dec 1680, William Glasgow, son of John Glasgow and Margaret Currie, 687/ M FR16.</ref>
